_note: Targets under test (label and description are shown in the report), plus the simulated user and the judge. Prices are USD per 1M tokens: check them against each vendor's pricing page before relying on cost figures. Keys come from GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. A target is vendor + model + settings + prompt variant, so the same model with two prompts is a prompt A/B test.

targets.label: Gemini Flash, plain prompt
targets.description: Gemini Flash with a three-sentence tutor prompt: who the tutor is, who the learner is, and "help them learn", with no guidance on how to talk. The baseline.

targets.label: Gemini Flash, coached prompt
targets.description: The same model and the same opening, plus explicit rules: short turns with one question at a time, mostly simple Spanish with English for support, gentle corrections by recasting, honest praise, and responding to hard news first. Tests whether those rules change behavior.
